control_failures.control_label: classification of a space and issue of an entry permit
standby attendance and non-entry rescue capability

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: loss of containment at HT-9002 during an intrusive maintenance task

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control CONFINED_SPACE_ENTRY_PERMIT: the classification of a space and issue of an entry permit had been bypassed, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

Control STANDBY_ATTENDANCE_AND_RESCUE: the standby attendance and non-entry rescue capability was never verified as effective, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next spot check that the classification of a space and issue of an entry permit on HT-9002 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in authorising and controlling entry, specifically classifying a space and issuing an entry permit. HT-9002 (haul trucks) is in service for waste and ore haulage. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the classification of a space and issue of an entry permit had been bypassed. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 27 July 2007 an incident occurred on HT-9002 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during an intrusive maintenance task, releasing kinetic energy held as rotating equipment.
